ratings_guide.title: 📊 RATINGS GUIDE
ratings_guide.con: CON — Contact: Determines the probability of making contact. High CON players have higher chances of singles and hits overall.
ratings_guide.pwr: PWR — Power: Probability of extra-base hits (doubles, triples, home runs). Also increases damage to opponent pitcher on deep hits.
ratings_guide.eye: EYE — Plate Discipline: Chance to draw Walks (BB). Deals 15 HP damage and fatigues the pitcher (+20% damage on next turn).
ratings_guide.k_avd: K/AVD — Strikeout Avoidance: Shrinks the strikeout (SO) zone on the dice roll. Essential for preventing direct HP damage caused by strikeouts.
ratings_guide.spd: SPD — Speed: Triggers base stealing attempts on singles (+20% pitcher damage debuff). Also grants 10% to 50% chance (10% + 1% per point above 60 SPD) to stretch singles and doubles into extra bases (1B→2B→3B).
ratings_guide.def: DEF — Defense: Contributes to team Shield. Higher average DEF gives you more shield to absorb OUTs before losing HP.
ratings_guide.captain: 👑 CAPTAIN: +5 to all ratings for all teammates while on the active roster.
ratings_guide.clutch: ⚡ CLUTCH PLAYER: +2% single and double chance, +4% HR chance with runners in scoring position or during the last inning.

fitness.fail: Massive muscle overload! The team exhausts and loses -15 Stamina.

gloves.fail: Leather tore mid-game! Costly defensive fielding errors.

pressure.name: 📈 Early Pressure

ghost.name: 🏃 Ghost Runners

legendary.name: 👑 Legendary Domination

back2back.name: 💥 Power Chain

midas.name: 🎰 Midas Touch

combat_info.title: ⚙️ DAMAGE DATA & VALUES
combat_info.out: ✋ OUT (Flyout/Groundout): Deals -20 HP to Shield (overflow hits Team HP). In Extra Innings: -30 HP.
combat_info.so:
💨 STRIKEOUT (SO): Direct Team HP damage (bypasses shield).
🔥 Streak: 1st (-20 HP) • 2nd (-26 HP) • 3rd+ (-32 HP)
⚡ Extra Innings: 1st (-30) • 2nd (-36) • 3rd+ (-42 HP)
combat_info.rbi_bonus: 🏆 RBI Bonus: Each RBI adds +10 extra HP damage to the pitcher.
combat_info.residual:
⚡ OVERFLOW DAMAGE (50%):
When KOing a pitcher, overflow damage carries over at 50% (÷2) to the incoming relief pitcher.
combat_info.defense:
🛡️ DEFENSIVE DUEL (Bottom of the Inning):
🛡️ Regular: +20 Shield (Fail: -10 HP)
⚡ Highlight Dive: +60 Shield (Fail: -30 HP)
💀 In Inning 3 & Extras: Any failure = Walk-Off Defeat!
combat_info.steal:
🏃 BASE STEALING:
• Steal 2B (on 1B/BB, SPD ≥ 40): Success based on runner's SPD.
• Steal 3B (on 2B, SPD ≥ 50): Success based on runner's SPD/2.
Stealing any base rattles the pitcher (+20% damage for 2 hits).
combat_info.upgrade:
⚡ HIT UPGRADES (SPD):
At SPD ≥ 60 (10% + 1% per point up to 50% max), runners stretch singles and doubles into extra bases (1B→2B→3B).
combat_info.shield_max: 🛡️ Shield: Average DEF of your 8 fielders (1 to 100).

run_intro.title: WELCOME TO BASEROGUE
run_intro.desc: Build your 9-batter lineup through draft rounds, arrange them tactically on the field, and advance by defeating rival pitching rotations. Roll the dice each turn to claim the championship!

chest.empty_desc: The treasure chest was empty in this stadium sector.

budget.title: All or Nothing (Triple Lottery)
budget.desc: Bet ALL your current budget on a single roll! If you win (50%), you TRIPLE your money (3x)! If you lose (50%), you walk away with $0.
budget.result_win: Total lottery triumph! You tripled your ${{staked}} and now have ${{newBudget}}.
budget.result_lose: The house wins! You lost your ${{staked}} stake. Current budget: $0.

scout.title: Mysterious Scout
scout.desc: A scout offers a free Legendary player for your weakest position. If you win, you sign them for free. If you lose, your best player suffers an injury: -20 to all stats.
scout.result_win: Legendary signing! {{newName}} joins the team at [{{pos}}] replacing {{oldName}}.
scout.result_lose: Disaster! {{name}} suffers a severe injury: -20 to all stats for the rest of the run.

synergy.title: Era Alchemy Pact
synergy.desc: Choose a player from your lineup: if you win, they count 4x toward their Era synergy. If you lose, 2 random teammates permanently lose Era synergy eligibility.
synergy.result_win: Alchemy success! {{name}} now counts 4x toward the {{era}} synergy.
synergy.result_lose: Pact failed! {{names}} lost their Era synergy eligibility for the rest of the run.
synergy.no_valid_target: No players available to swap synergy.

trade.title: Blind Trade (Weakest Starter)
trade.desc: Trade your weakest starting player for a blind offer. If you win (50%), you receive a guaranteed EPIC or LEGENDARY upgrade at that position. If you lose (50%), they are replaced by a Common (50 OVR) and the position is locked from draft for 1 full map (6 nodes).
trade.win_detail: (Turn your weakest link into an elite superstar)
trade.lose_detail: (Replaced by Common and position locked for 6 nodes)
trade.result_lose: Trade disaster: {{newName}} (Common) replaces {{oldName}} at [{{pos}}]. Position locked for 1 full map (6 nodes).
trade.no_target: No eligible players for the trade.

soldier.title: Super-Slugger Serum
soldier.desc: Inject an experimental serum into your chosen batter. If you win (50%), they permanently gain +35 Contact and +35 Power. If you lose (50%), they suffer chronic fatigue: -15 to all stats.
soldier.result_win: Titanic breakthrough! {{name}} gains +35 CON and +35 PWR permanently!
soldier.result_lose: Cellular rejection: {{name}} suffers chronic fatigue (-15 to all stats).

market.title: Black Market Equipment
market.desc: Negotiate with an underground smuggler. If you win (50%), you receive 2 Supreme Equipment Items (+35 stats) in your backpack. If you lose (50%), you get ambushed: lose $20 budget and all 9 roster players suffer -30 Stamina.
market.result_lose: Alleyway ambush! You lost ${{budget}} and all players suffered -30 Stamina in the scuffle.

defense.title: Underground Gold Glove
defense.desc: Gamble on transforming your defense into an impenetrable wall. If you win (50%), ALL 9 roster players receive +20 DEF permanently. If you lose (50%), your 3 starting outfielders (LF, CF, RF) suffer permanent lapse: -15 DEF.
defense.result_win: Impenetrable wall! All 9 starters receive +20 DEF permanently.
